source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Related command variants were searched and do not replace this coverage.

source_snapshot.master: Master accepts command success only and does not validate vendor layout, fan count, PWM range, tachometers or thermal context.
source_snapshot.comparison: Exact-row DeepSeek and GPT V2 were checked against Master semantics.

historical_reviews.history: Neighboring records and target-specific semantics checked.

original_test_intent: Read OEM fan-control mode and per-fan PWM vector and correlate it with physical tachometer and thermal state.
original_method: Original Master source is retained verbatim; Review adds a safe bounded method.
manual_activity: Project supplies vendor response layout, expected fan inventory and operating context.
agent_execution_scope: Run only the bounded approved command
engineer_actions: Approve inputs, limits and recovery; own DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not accepted blindly; missing fields, credential handling and semantic coverage were corrected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Issue vendor 0x30/0x22, parse mode and exactly the configured fan count, then correlate each PWM with tach/thermal telemetry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Original fields/timing are preserved and absent bytes are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Issue vendor 0x30/0x22, parse mode and exactly the configured fan count, then correlate each PWM with tach/thermal telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects execution and acceptance only in Review.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Readback does not validate Set Fan Speed Control transitions.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Variable OEM payload length can silently shift fan indices.

project_override_considerations: Alternate tools are allowed only with approved equivalence and explicit disclosure of unverified original-tool/raw-command coverage.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master accepts command success only and does not validate vendor layout, fan count, PWM range, tachometers or thermal context.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Core operation is identifiable; target values and approval are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Adds fan-count and physical-response validation to the OEM read.
independent_technical_reasoning: A PWM byte is meaningful only for the correct fan index and current control mode. Exact payload length and fan inventory prevent shifted decoding, while tach and temperature correlation detect stale or implausible controller state.
